analysis.file_name: Erasca Inc. (ERAS)_ ERAS-0015 (pan-RAS) data at Triple Meeting is encouraging and suggests potential to differentiate.pdf
analysis.title: Erasca Inc. (ERAS): ERAS-0015 (pan-RAS) data at Triple Meeting is encouraging and suggests potential to differentiate
key_insights: ERAS presented updated ERAS-0015 (oral pan-RAS) monotherapy data at the EORTC-NCI-AACR Triple Meeting on 20 Nov 2026: 44% confirmed ORR in 2L+ PDAC (n=25) and 50% confirmed ORR in 2L+ NSCLC (n=10), both at 32mg.

Stock fell 1.5% on the data, roughly in line with XBI intraday. GS reads the muted reaction as efficacy and tolerability expectations already priced in, and views the data as encouraging against both expectations and the key debate of differentiation versus RVMD's daraxonrasib.
PDAC: 44% cORR (n=25) and 88% disease control at 32mg. One confirmed PR later reached an unconfirmed CR. All 11 responders remained on treatment at cutoff. Median DoR and PFS are not yet reported.

GS compares the 44% PDAC cORR with daraxonrasib's 32% ORR in RASOLUTE-302 (cross-trial caveats). The ERAS-0015 population was more heavily pretreated (84% 3L+ vs 100% 2L) and had more KRAS G12R mutations (44% vs 12%), where lower responses would be expected.
KRAS G12R activity was 18% cORR for ERAS-0015 versus 7% in RASOLUTE-302. ERAS-0015 showed 69% in G12D/V patients.

NSCLC: 50% cORR (n=10) in 2L+ and 60% (n=5) in post-ICI/platinum 2L/3L at 32mg. All 10 patients remained on treatment (five confirmed PR, five stable disease). The dataset is small and immature. A potentially registration-enabling 2L+ monotherapy study is planned for 1H27.

Tolerability at 32mg: 100% median relative dose intensity, 13% dose interruptions, 17% dose reductions, no treatment-related discontinuations. Rash, stomatitis and GI events were mostly low grade, with no prophylaxis recommended.

Management contrasts this with daraxonrasib, where prophylaxis is recommended and interruptions exceed 50%. It sees avoiding prophylaxis as a possible commercial differentiator, especially in community oncology.

1L PDAC pivotal initiation was pulled forward to 1H27 from 2027. 24mg ERAS-0015 plus gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel (GnP) dosing is ongoing, with plans to explore 32mg. That would allow combining at the likely monotherapy dose, versus daraxonrasib's 200mg in its Ph3.
Daraxonrasib plus GnP showed about 61% ORR (n=61) with 12.8 months median PFS at Triple. GS calls this a clear benchmark for ERAS in 1L PDAC.

Combinations: ERAS-0015 cleared 16mg, 24mg and 32mg DLT windows with pembrolizumab with no DLT. 1L NSCLC dose escalation with carboplatin/pemetrexed/pembrolizumab began in 4Q26. In CRC, both evaluable patients on 24mg plus panitumumab had ongoing confirmed PRs (both later reduced to 16mg), and 1 of 4 patients at 16mg had an unconfirmed PR. A CRC dose will be selected in 2027.

Catalysts: 1H27 combination data (at least CRC, possibly PDAC and NSCLC), pivotal trial initiations (particularly 1L PDAC), 2L+ NSCLC monotherapy study start in 1H27, a potentially pivotal 1L study in 2H27-1H28, CRC combination dose selection, and ERAS-4001 data including ERAS-4001 plus ERAS-0015 dose escalation in 2027.
GS carries an Early-Stage Biotech designation on ERAS, so there is no rating or price target. The stock closed at $14.22 on 19 Nov 2026, with a $4.4bn market cap and $4.1bn enterprise value.

market_movers.rationale: GS views ERAS-0015 data as encouraging and potentially differentiated versus daraxonrasib. The stock fell 1.5% on the day, which GS reads as expectations already priced in. No rating or price target under the Early-Stage Biotech designation.

Daraxonrasib is the benchmark for ERAS-0015. GS flags its 32% ORR in 2L PDAC and its prophylaxis recommendation and over 50% interruption rate as areas where ERAS-0015 may differentiate. Daraxonrasib plus GnP in 1L PDAC (about 61% ORR, 12.8 months median PFS) sets a high bar.

sector_views.rationale: GS frames pan-RAS as a competitive field with ERAS-0015 showing potential for differentiation on efficacy in a heavily pretreated PDAC population and on tolerability without prophylaxis. Cross-trial comparisons carry caveats and durability data are immature.

risk_factors: Cross-trial comparisons with daraxonrasib carry caveats because populations, geographies and cut dates differ.
NSCLC dataset is small (n=10, with n=5 in the post-ICI/platinum subset) and immature.
Median DoR, PFS and OS are not yet reported in either PDAC or NSCLC.
KRAS G12R activity is low at 18% cORR.
Exact 1L PDAC pivotal design is still to be determined.
Daraxonrasib plus GnP in 1L PDAC (about 61% ORR, 12.8 months median PFS) sets a high benchmark.
ERAS-0015 is not recommended for prophylaxis, but rash, stomatitis and GI adverse events still occurred (Gr3+ rash 14%, stomatitis 12%).
vol_and_positioning: ERAS fell 1.5% on the data day, roughly in line with XBI intraday. GS reads this as efficacy and tolerability expectations already built into the price.

tension_points.bull_case: 44% cORR in 2L+ PDAC beats daraxonrasib's 32% ORR despite a more pretreated population (84% 3L+) and more G12R mutations (44% vs 12%). Tolerability at 32mg without prophylaxis (13% interruptions, 17% reductions) versus daraxonrasib's over 50% interruptions. Pivotal 1L PDAC timing pulled forward to 1H27.
tension_points.bear_case: Cross-trial comparisons carry caveats. Median DoR and PFS are not yet reported. The NSCLC dataset is small. Daraxonrasib plus GnP in 1L PDAC (about 61% ORR, 12.8 months median PFS) sets a high bar. The muted stock reaction suggests expectations were already high.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Weak 1H27 combination data or 1L PDAC pivotal design and progress that fail to show differentiation against daraxonrasib plus GnP (about 61% ORR, 12.8 months median PFS).

theme_stances.key_argument: ERAS-0015's 44% PDAC cORR in a heavily pretreated population and its tolerability without prophylaxis suggest potential differentiation from daraxonrasib.
theme_stances.evidence: believe the data are encouraging relative to expectations
